item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot during the day with a few showers over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China in the latter part of this week. With the trough of low pressure edging closer to the coastal areas gradually, there will be more showers with squally thunderstorms over the region on Sunday and early next week.
